verdict.rationale: Claude Code is explicitly designed to be operated via plain-language instructions—describing tasks, git workflows, MCP tool use, and even natural-language chat commands (@claude in Slack, GitHub) all documented as core interaction modes, and GitHub docs explicitly state it works 'all through natural language commands.' missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarking specifically confirming natural-language command comprehension breadth/accuracy versus slash-command or scripted usage, and some community reports note failure modes/hallucination under natural language instructions reducing reliability.
